changelog:
Initial release of the Auto Dealership & Car Service Marketing Kit skill.

- Generates FTC/NADA/state DMV-compliant marketing content for auto dealers, used car lots, and service shops.
- Four comprehensive prompt systems: inventory promotion, service marketing, review management, and digital advertising.
- Ensures automated inclusion of all required legal/regulatory disclosures for ads and communications.
- Designed for dealerships, auto service chains, independent lots, and marketing agencies.
- Offers tiered pricing: free introductory prompt, paid full access, done-for-you campaigns, and agency retainers.
summary: Generates FTC/NADA/state DMV-compliant marketing content for auto dealers and service shops covering inventory, service upsells, reviews, and digital ads.
